title: Ain'y Got You
original_lyrics:
[verse]
I got fortune of heaven in diamonds and gold
I got all the bonds baby that the bank could hold
I got houses 'cross the country honey end to end
And everybody buddy wants to be my friend
Well I got all the riches honey any man every knew

[bridge]
I got house full of Rembrandt and priceless art
And all the little girls they wanna tear me apart
When I walk down the street people stop and stare
Well you think I might be thrilled but baby I don't care

[bridge]
I got big diamond watch sittin' on my wrist
I try to tempt you baby but you just resist
I made deal with the devil babe I won't deny
Until I got you in my arms I can't be satisfied
I got pound of caviar sitting home on ice
I got fancy foreign car that rides like paradise
I got hundred pretty women knockin' down my door
And folks wanna kiss me I ain't even seen before
I been around the world and all across the seven seas

[bridge]
'Cause the only thing I ain't got baby I ain't got you
